entities.summary: Edwin Chapin Starks was an ichthyologist most associated with Stanford University. He was known as an authority on the osteology of fish. He also did studies of fish of the Puget Sound. His wife, Chloe Lesley Starks, an artist and scientific illustrator, and daughter, Dorothy Rich, a radiologist, were also both involved in science. Edwin Chapin Starks was a naturalists & biologists from Baraboo (1867-01-25, Baraboo–1932-12-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
